//: Policy for scripts/scrub-recordings.mjs. See CONTRIBUTING.md § Recordings must be scrubbed.
//no-names-here: This file names no account, and none may be added. Which handles survive a scrub is DERIVED, not declared: any handle a test source references is an account the suite asserts against, so it and its bio stay; every other handle in a capture is an incidental third party and is pseudonymised. That keeps the rule in one place — if a test stops naming an account, the next scrub anonymises it automatically, and the recording account (which no test names) is removed without ever being written down.
//testSources: Scanned to find those referenced handles. Globs are relative to the repo root.
//dropMedia: Response bodies discarded outright. Video is the largest non-JS payload and no test asserts on it.
//keepsData: Never touched, because the extension is tested against them: about_profile.account_based_in (country), about_profile.source (app store), location_accurate, and created_at.
